cells.gaps: No reporting row for the Vision, and its governance rows (2022-09, UGA-019, UGA-020) fall outside the 36-month window. Also holds rows for the Digital Transformation Roadmap 2023/24-2027/28 (newer, launched 2023 by the Ministry/Government, source verbs 'developed' and 'launched', no adopting act and no public text on record, so announced only); an adoption act or published roadmap text would make it the instrument in force. The Vision's adoption rests on the read-as-adopted rule, with no approval act named.
cells.note: Vision for a Digital Uganda 2040, published by the Ministry with the President's foreword and not called a draft, is read as adopted with public text and a period to 2040, so stage 3. Stage 4 needs published reporting, and none is held.
